# Recorded step-judge results

Three synthetic episodes of one made-up app and the judge results saved for them
(`quality_judge.json`). `tests/test_quality_judge.py` scores them and re-runs the judge
over them with no key and no network.

The answers were written by hand for these episodes. No model produced them, and the
model id in the files is a placeholder. The reference steps of the made-up case are in
the test module.
